prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 多级表头 · 半年度指标 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "指标" spans 1 col × 2 row; "2023 年" spans 2 col × 1 row; "2024 年" spans 2 col × 1 row; "备注" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "指标" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 123px
  col 2: header "2023 年 › 上半年" · longest unbreakable word 45px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "2023 年 › 下半年" · longest unbreakable word 45px · one-line width 46px
  col 4: header "2024 年 › 上半年" · longest unbreakable word 45px · one-line width 46px
  col 5: header "2024 年 › 下半年" · longest unbreakable word 43px · one-line width 46px
  col 6: header "备注" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 349px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
This table cannot fit without splitting words at 360px. You MAY choose a total wider than 359px (the reader then scrolls horizontally), or squeeze and accept splits — a design decision.
Rendering convention: the screenshot always shows the WHOLE table. Anything beyond the dashed box is not clipped; it is the part a reader reaches by scrolling sideways, so judge both what fits in the box at first sight and the cost of scrolling to the rest.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"比较营业收入、毛利率和研发投入在2023年与2024年各半年的变化，并阅读相关备注。","reading":"读者先按行识别指标，再横向比较四个半年度数值；备注提供解释，可在比较数值后阅读。","groups":["第1列是行标题，应与同一行的四个数值保持清晰对应。","第2至5列都是半年度数值，按年份两两分组，适合采用一致的宽度以便横向比较。","第6列是说明性文字，内容较长，可比数值列更灵活地换行。"],"keep_intact":["半年度表头和各期数值，尤其是百分比及其百分号。","指标名称应尽量完整，避免难以辨认的逐字拆分。"],"may_wrap":["备注可按中文语义自然换行，并利用同行其他单元格换行形成的行高。","空间紧张时，指标名称可在自然语义边界换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [90, 67, 67, 67, 67, 145] · table 504×252px · row heights [36, 36, 83, 36, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/8 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 144px
Design r2B: widths [105, 67, 67, 67, 67, 160] · table 534×252px · row heights [36, 36, 83, 36, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/8 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 174px
Design r2C: widths [90, 67, 67, 67, 67, 190] · table 549×252px · row heights [36, 36, 83, 36, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/8 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 189px

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"四个半年度列等宽，表头和数值完整，便于按行比较；指标名称分两行后仍容易辨认。四期数据恰好都在首屏内。","problems":"备注几乎完全落在首屏之外，需要横向滚动才能阅读；较长备注使部分数据行显得偏高。","cause":"指标列为90px、四个数值列各67px，合计358px，已用完视口宽度；145px的备注列位于其后，且仍不足以让最长备注少于三行。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"数值列保持等宽，表头、数值和指标名称都清晰完整；较宽的备注列为说明文字提供了更多空间。","problems":"首屏右边界切入最后一个半年度列，影响四期数值的连续比较；表格比r2A更宽，但行高没有减少。","cause":"指标列增至105px，使前五列合计373px；备注列增至160px后，现有文字仍产生与r2A相同的行高。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"四个半年度列完整呈现在首屏，宽备注列让说明文字有较从容的横向空间。","problems":"备注需要滚动才能阅读，横向滚动距离是三者中最长的；增加宽度没有缩短表格或降低最高行的高度。","cause":"前五列合计358px，备注列从视口边缘开始；190px的备注列使总宽达到549px，但行高仍与r2A相同。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"compact-note","widths":[90,67,67,67,67,125],"change":"保留r2A中首屏可见的完整四期数据，将备注列缩至125px，减少横向滚动；观察备注是否增加行数或产生不自然的断行。"},{"name":"earlier-note","widths":[75,67,67,67,67,145],"change":"将指标列缩至75px，使备注列的开头更早进入首屏，同时保持四期数据等宽完整；检查指标名称的换行是否仍自然、易于识别。"},{"name":"balanced-label","widths":[83,67,67,67,67,135],"change":"在指标列和备注列之间取折中：让备注开头稍微进入首屏，并比r2A减少总宽；检查指标及备注的换行是否仍保持清晰的行对应关系。"}]}
